start.title: Try the demo
start.intro: The demo opens Ladu with sample words, tags and a practice setup. It lasts a few minutes. When it ends, all your changes are deleted.
start.termsNote: By starting the demo, you confirm that you are at least 13 years old (with a parent's permission if you are under 16) and accept the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
start.logoutWarning: You are logged in. Starting the demo logs you out of your account.
start.buttonLogout: Log out and start the demo

off.title: The demo is off
off.text: The demo is not available now. You can create a free account instead.

ended.title: The demo has ended
ended.text: All the changes you made in the demo are deleted. Create an account to keep your own words.

errors.demo_busy: Too many demos are running. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.demo_rate_limited: Too many demos were started from your network. Try again later.
errors.demo_unavailable: The demo is not available now. Try again later.
errors.generic: The demo could not start. Try again.
